en.t: Lamps had already been lit everywhere.

units.source_text: 内大臣退朝，乘便来接云居雁回邸。

en.t: The Minister of the Interior had withdrawn from court and came by on the way to take Kumoinokari back to his mansion.
The men clearing the way shouted loudly.

units.source_text: 邸内的人都说：“老爷来了！”

en.t: Everyone in the mansion said, "The master has come!"
For a while there was a great commotion.

units.source_text: 云居雁非常害怕，全身发抖。

en.t: Kumoinokari was terribly frightened and trembled all over.

units.source_text: 夕雾由他骚乱，不顾一切，决不放走云居雁。

en.t: Yugiri let the commotion rage on, caring for nothing else, and would not let Kumoinokari go.

units.source_text: 云居雁的乳母来找小姐，看见了这光景，心中只是叫苦，想道：“哎呀，这还了得？

en.t: Kumoinokari's nurse came looking for the young lady, saw the scene, and could only inwardly lament, thinking, "Oh no, how can this be allowed?

units.source_text: 而且看来老太太是早就知情的。”

en.t: And from the look of it, the old lady has known about this all along."
What a dreadful state of affairs!

units.source_text: 老爷知道了要生气，自不必说，那位按察大纳言老爷知道了，不知又怎么样哩。

en.t: It goes without saying that the master will be furious when he learns of it, and who knows what His Excellency the Inspector Grand Counselor will do if he hears.

units.source_text: 不管你何等才貌双全，初婚嫁个六位小京官，也太不体面了。”

en.t: No matter how gifted and beautiful you are, it is far too disgraceful for your first marriage to be to a minor sixth-rank court official."

units.source_text: 说着，一直走到屏风背后来，埋怨这一对情人。

en.t: As she spoke, she walked straight behind the screen and reproached the two lovers.

units.source_text: 夕雾听到她的话，知道自己官位太低，故被乳母轻视，不免怨恨世事之不公，恋情也略略减兴了。

en.t: Hearing her words, Yugiri realized that his rank was too low and that the nurse looked down on him for it; he could not help resenting the unfairness of the world, and his passion cooled a little.

units.source_text: 便对云居雁说：“请听乳母的话！

en.t: So he said to Kumoinokari, "Please listen to your nurse!
